runtime.transport_owner: spatial model or explicitly coupled particle/cell host

target.supporting_charged_species: Retain every ion/anion introduced by accepted reaction channels, with its own state and energy requirements.
target.time_window_note: Early-time study scope only; actual source/measurement clock registration remains explicit and input-owned.
target.fit_status: No physical density, neutral temperature or absolute intensity fit admitted.

state_bases.requirements: Keep metastable2s distinct from Ly-alpha-emitting2p; converge upper n/l cutoff and fine-structure treatment against recorded features.

state_bases.generated_raikou_mechanism: tools/neutral_cr_probe.py exports a sourced radiative subgraph
state_bases.requirements: Preserve source parity labels, map collision-data state basis and nuclear-spin convention, supply level energies/weights, omitted electronic-state cascades and relevant triplet/metastable channels.
Excitation mechanism and dissociation formation pumping must determine state populations; the A-X diagnostic near308nm is outside the retained VUV window.
Use polyatomic quantum labels; retain dissociative electronic states/continua and state-specific fragment channels rather than stable invented vibrational levels.
state_bases.existing_scaffold: Raikou mechanisms/h2o_research.json has ground+two vibrational placeholders, not a full water state model.

state_bases.requirements: Water dissociation can feed oxygen emitters; do not assign every VUV feature to H/H2.

rate_families.input: state-resolved cross sections plus shared EEDF, or explicitly qualified thermal rate tables
state-resolved electron and relevant heavy collision rates; assess density-dependent importance
state-dependent losses and outgoing state/energy branching

rate_families.double_counting_rule: Do not sum a total ionization channel and all of its partial fragment channels as independent losses.

rate_families.input: canonical source states, internal distributions, fragment recoil and one parent-inventory accounting

source_and_electron_inputs.neutral_transport: Four-face packet/map fields exist as provisional independent-source cases; not yet accepted state-resolved receiver populations.
source_and_electron_inputs.physical_source_basis: configs/neutral_cr_water_inventory_source.json: one common H2O parent inventory N_ML*sigma_ML over actual face areas; no independent water-derived fragment source pools.
source_and_electron_inputs.source_internal_states: H/H2/H2O/OH assumed_source_state IDs require physical electronic/rovibrational mapping.
source_and_electron_inputs.physical_source_state_policy: The new water-derived source inserts H2O only. H/H2/OH/O and ions are generated by accepted chemistry; initial nonwater contaminants require separately declared inventories. Historical independent-pool GIFs remain historical controls.
source_and_electron_inputs.electron_history: n_e(t,cell), EEDF(t,cell) or independently justified electron closure, collision-data provenance and excitation clock are missing.
source_and_electron_inputs.temperature_separation: Electrode, neutral translation, molecular rotation/vibration and electron energy remain separate; never set Te from MFEM wall temperature.
source_and_electron_inputs.energy: Accepted event energy partitions must close internal, translational, electron and photon accounts; prescribed environments remain prescribed rather than self-consistent.
source_and_electron_inputs.coverage_rescaling: Only a verified linear source/transport/CR/thin-observation regime with prescribed electrons admits proportional inventory/light scaling; full density-dependent chemistry, quenching, feedback and opacity require recomputed cases.
source_and_electron_inputs.optical_scale_identifiability: Unknown absolute optical/detector throughput is confounded with initial_h2o_monolayers in a linear amplitude regime; constrain the throughput scale or report an unresolved joint fit. An undefined sigma_ML adds another inventory-to-monolayer degeneracy.

observation_inputs.collection: Simulation ray-cell paths and collection weights enter once; detector throughput/etendue/gate/bin-width allocation are separate.
observation_inputs.opacity: Assess optical depth on actual spatial states and rays before opting into thin transfer; a standalone slab escape factor is not a replacement for ordered transfer.
observation_inputs.profiles: Use emitting-state velocity/fragment-recoil distributions and qualified instrument response;0.03nm/pixel is sampling, not a measured Gaussian FWHM.
observation_inputs.measured_quantity: Recovered dissertation transition-density displays require an explicit reduction/radiance mapping before absolute fitting.

acceptance_sequence: Freeze canonical state/rate/cross-section provenance and uncertainty on retained support.
Validate rate completeness and atomic/molecular nuclei, charge and event-energy balances.
Run transient per-cell native controls with independent analytic/reference cases, without imposing QSS by default.
Import the real source with conserved state/inventory/energy/placement readback and time registration.
Advance chemistry with prescribed/solved electron histories and transport coupling, retaining velocity and state distributions.
Project through actual collection geometry, transfer and detector response; integrate contained3ns gates.
Converge state, spatial, time, transport and spectral features before comparing density/temperature hypotheses.

primary_research_sources.use: Molecular hydrogen CR process/density sensitivity; missing excited-state electron rates remain a physical issue.
Candidate state-resolved collision data; source policy requires obtaining data from provider and does not authorize third-party redistribution.
Atomic energy levels/wavelengths/A values, not a complete electron-collision model.
Primarily total molecular ionization; not a complete resolved molecular excitation dataset.
